Then he climbed the tower, polished the lens, and lit the lamp early, though the sun still hung above the water, just in case.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在一层薄薄的蓝灰色里。路灯孤零零地亮着，把空荡荡的街道照得发白。环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，沙沙声传得很远。远处的便利店亮着灯，像一只不肯睡去的眼睛。高楼的窗大多是黑的，偶尔有一两扇透出微光，不知是谁在失眠。风带着凉意穿过天桥，送来早点铺揉面的声音。天边还没有亮，可是新的一天已经在悄悄醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of nesting dolls: you open one doll and find a smaller doll, and you keep going until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- That tiniest doll is the stopping point, and without it the opening would never end."}
